title: libddb normalized entry path
description: DDBNormalizePath (XI-09): the normalized dataset-relative path, or the code of the first rule that rejects it (src/include/entry_path.h). Also the 'expected' value of every vector in vectors/entry-paths.json.

path.description: '/' separated, no leading, trailing or repeated '/', no '.' or '..' segment, no '\'
